# Expected control-flow specification (not asserted as OCR output until baseline is reviewed)
1. terminal: Start
2. data: Input n
3. decision: n > 0?
4. process: Print Positive
5. process: Print Other
6. terminal: End

Directed edges:
n1 -> n2
n2 -> n3
n3 -> n4 [Yes]
n3 -> n5 [No]
n4 -> n6
n5 -> n6
